title: Springfield, MO — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Springfield, MO: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Springfield is a city in MO with a population of 170,000. Queen City of the Ozarks with Bass Pro Shops headquarters and outdoor recreation. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.6.
